meta.name: Forge spec pipeline
meta.honest_note: No decision/scoring logic in this file. Its intelligence is validation discipline + deterministic generation.

validation_idiom.desc: Untrusted input -> safe action in one pass. Template for Director task intake.
steps: clamp every number with explicit min/max/default

ingest_pattern: Per-item try/catch, collect error strings, require >=1 success, report 'N ready · M skipped'. Never let one bad row kill the batch. Use for task batches and HTML imports.

phyllotaxis.desc: Optimal even distribution of N items, 3 lines.

profile_dispatch.desc: kind -> profile -> parameter policy. 20-line policy engine.

telemetry_shape: One function returning the complete machine-readable state object; render as ?telemetry=json. Mirror for the star system's live engine state.
provenance: Every output carries {agent, quote}: 'no naked claims' as a data convention.
